findings.title: Committed formal artifacts carry stale current-HEAD provenance
findings.evidence: All three committed checker JSON files report generated_at_head_sha 77bf676 while repository HEAD is 5e5e008. Fresh make formal is deterministic but changes the tracked files to current-HEAD stamps.
findings.impact: A consumer cannot establish that the committed formal outputs were generated at the revision that contains them.
findings.required_fix: Regenerate and commit all formal outputs at the release HEAD, or redesign the provenance stamp so publication-only commits do not immediately stale the committed artifacts.

findings.title: The documented Tectonic arXiv fallback cannot pass its own gates
findings.evidence: Pinned Tectonic 0.17.0 produced a 19-page PDF in two builds with identical file lists and page counts, but make arxiv exited 2 both times: G1 expects a main.log Tectonic does not produce, and G4/G6 text gates are compiler/extraction-sensitive.
findings.impact: The declared fallback build path is not a successful reproducible release path; rebuilding also changes the committed PDF and parity report.
findings.required_fix: Make all gates compiler-aware and demonstrate a clean make arxiv under each documented compiler, then commit outputs and the parity report from the declared release toolchain.

findings.title: The committed parity report obscures an allowed raw numeric delta
findings.status: KNOWN ISSUE; NON-BLOCKING; NO FURTHER ROUND
findings.evidence: G3 reports raw totals 689 and 688 while normalized differences are empty. Independent extraction found exactly one legitimate superscript flattening: Markdown tokens 2 and 31 become PDF token 231, with no unexplained differences.
findings.recommended_fix: Show raw and post-allowlist totals separately and enumerate every applied exception in the report.

research_artifact.justification: The central scientific claims, corrected theorem, finite checks, 30-seed statistics, persisted-evidence audit, direct CH7 probes, and qualified negative results are unusually well evidenced. Prior severity-1 scientific overclaims are repaired. The remaining deductions are for release-provenance and package reproducibility, not a newly discovered false scientific result.

software_engineering.justification: The pinned bootstrap, 176-test suite, deterministic seed replays, stable-sum regeneration, schema validation, durable substitution log, build dependencies, and mutation score are strong. The stale formal provenance at final HEAD and a documented compiler fallback that cannot pass its own gates prevent a higher score.
